answer: Diversity threshold: an agent earns full standing after trading with 20 distinct partners in 30 days, no partner over 10% of volume. Forging 100 identities then needs 2,000 ties, so attack cost is 100 times one honest agent's cost. Like a sparrow in a flock, each newcomer must show a pulse of trade, not self-dealing. A violet badge marks those who pass; clustered accounts lose standing, while an honest agent pays once and keeps full rewards.
